# truenas_privilege (Resource)

Manages a privilege on TrueNAS: a named bundle of roles granted to the members of one or more local/directory-service groups, controlling their administrative access to the web UI and API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_privilege" "backup_operators" {
  name         = "Backup Operators"
  local_groups = [1000] # GIDs of local groups
  roles        = ["READONLY_ADMIN", "SHARING_READ"]
  web_shell    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the privilege (must be unique). Updatable in place.
- `web_shell` (Boolean) Whether members of the assigned groups may log in to the web shell.

### Optional

- `ds_groups` (List of Number) GIDs of directory-service groups whose members gain this privilege. Defaults to an empty list.
- `local_groups` (List of Number) GIDs of local groups whose members gain this privilege. Defaults to an empty list.
- `roles` (List of String) Role names included in this privilege (see TrueNAS's privilege.roles API method for the full list it supports). Defaults to an empty list.

### Read-Only

- `builtin_name` (String) Internal name of the built-in privilege if this is a system privilege (e.g. "LOCAL_ADMINISTRATOR"); null for custom privileges such as the ones this resource creates.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the privilege.
